Class MainCabin

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.model.components.Component
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.model.components.MainCabin
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class MainCabin extends Component
Represents the main cabin component of a spaceship. The main cabin is the central component that holds crew members and has a specific color. It can accommodate a maximum of 2 crew members.

  • Constructor Details

    • MainCabin

      public MainCabin(int id, String name, Map<Side,Connector> connector, Side orientation, Color color)
      Creates a new MainCabin component with the specified properties. The cabin is initialized with 2 crew members by default.
      Parameters:
      id - the unique identifier for this component
      name - the name of the component
      connector - a map of connectors indexed by their side position
      orientation - the current orientation of the component
      color - the color of the main cabin

  • Method Details

    • modifyCrewMembers

      public boolean modifyCrewMembers(int change)
      Modifies the number of crew members in the main cabin by the specified amount. The main cabin can accommodate between 0 and 2 crew members (inclusive).
      Overrides:
      modifyCrewMembers in class Component
      Parameters:
      change - the amount to add (if positive) or subtract (if negative) from the current number of crew members
      Returns:
      true if the modification was successfully applied, false if the change would result in an invalid number of crew members (less than 0 or greater than 2)
